newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ECE SA to launch IPO.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ECE SA to launch IPO.

text.p: Restaurant franchise holder ECE SA said on Wednesday it launched a primary and secondary initial public offering on the Mexican Stock Exchange.
ECE will offer 22,964,387 shares, 15,017,143 primary shares and 7,947,244 secondary shares, at a price of 11 pesos per share, the company said in newspaper ads.
The offer will raise 252,608,257 pesos, the company said. The offer began on Wednesday and will last through Thursday.
ECE owns the franchises for Hard Rock Cafe, Planet Hollywood, Rainforest and Official All-Star Cafe in Mexico.
The offer represents 15.29 percent of the company's total share capital of 150,171,429 shares.
The offer has a "greenshoe," or oversubscription allotment, of 2,252,571 shares, or 1.47 percent of share capital, the company said.
Santander Investment and Invermexico brokerage were acting as lead agents, the company said.
